postmenopausal_bleeding.title: Bleeding after menopause
postmenopausal_bleeding.body: You logged bleeding or spotting. Any bleeding 12 months or more after your last period should be checked by a doctor. Usually the cause is simple, but an early check matters.

checkup_overdue.title: A checkup is overdue
checkup_overdue.body: {checkup} is past its due time. Booking it soon keeps your health plan on track.

score_worsened.title: Your symptom score went up
score_worsened.body: Your latest score is {total}, {delta} points higher than the time before ({previous}). Note what changed, and talk to your doctor if it stays high.

hrt_review.title: Treatment review coming up
hrt_review.body: {when}: the review of {name} with your doctor ({date}). Write down how you have felt and any side effects to take with you.

checkup_due.title: A checkup is due
checkup_due.body: It is time for {checkup}. Regular checks matter more for your bones and heart after menopause.
